# **The Agent Harness Hackathon**

## Event overview

**Hosted by [HackerSquad](https://hackersquad.io) and [TrueFoundry](https://truefoundry.com)**

Held at INNO VALLEY, in collaboration with [AI Global Campus (AGC)](https://aiglobalcampus.com/).

**When:** Saturday, Sep 19, 2026 · 9:30 AM–8:00 PM PT

**Where:** 3120 Scott Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95054

Sponsored by OpenAI

# **About the event**

A full-day hackathon for engineers and technical founders building AI agent applications with TrueForge. Take a use case from prototype toward production, with practical work on model routing, MCP tools, tracing, evaluations, permissions, retries, cost controls, and deployment.

# **What to expect**

* Check-in and setup, followed by the Agent Harness introduction and challenge brief.  
* Focused build time with technical support, then project submissions and selected demos.  
* Judging, awards, closing remarks, and networking.

**Prizes:** 1st place $2,000 · 2nd place $1,000 · 3rd place $500

**Admission:** Free; registration and host approval required.

**Bring:** A laptop, a concrete agent use case or prototype, and any teammates you plan to build with.

[Event details and registration on Luma](https://luma.com/truefoundry-agent-harness-hackathon-sep19-2026)

# **INNO VALLEY \+ AI Global Campus**

## Event resource guide

3120 Scott Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95054

# **Why this venue is a strong fit**

## **INNO VALLEY**

* **AI and hardware community.** InnoX’s events at its Silicon Valley base bring together founders, students, and global partners around AI and hardware.  
* **Practical startup insight.** Past programming has covered supply chains, finance, talent, and international growth—useful context for teams turning prototypes into products.

Sources: [InnoX Silicon Valley community](https://cn.linkedin.com/company/innox-shenzhen) · [InnoX event programming](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/innox-shenzhen_ces-innovalley-ai-activity-7417154542196334593-YpwR)

## **AI Global Campus**

* **Demo and feedback focus.** AGC supports AI and robotics showcases, demo planning, and early audience feedback—a relevant setting for a build-and-demo event.  
* **Potential next steps for projects.** Its services include customer and partner connections, market-entry exploration, and early pilot planning.  
* **Learning and collaboration.** AGC explores hands-on workshops, student demos, and industry events with education and community partners.

Sources: [AGC services](https://aiglobalcampus.com/services) · [AGC partnerships](https://aiglobalcampus.com/partnerships)
